Added /app/backend/tests/test_redesign.py — 12/12 pass: security-questions on register (persistence + case-insensitive answers + wrong-answer 400 + 404 paths), admin-only image upload (jpg/png/webp validation, ≤5MB enforcement, RBAC), and /api/files/{path} serving uploaded bytes with image content-type and no auth. Frontend verified at 390x844 (mobile) and 1920x1080 (admin desktop): Login/Register/ForgotPassword all expose ThemeToggle; theme persists in localStorage 'ni_theme' (light↔dark switches html.dark class). Register has q1/a1/q2/a2 testids. ForgotPassword has the 2-tab UI (mode-questions/mode-admin) + step1 visible. Logged in as 08099887766/newpwd → dashboard shows NO old 4 stat cards and NO active investments list; featured-plan + cta-team + cta-coupon + cta-packages all render. Mobile bottom nav has exactly Home/Invest/Packages/Team/More — Deposit/Withdraw are NOT there but ARE inside the More sheet (more-deposit/more-withdraw). /my-packages renders with pkg-filter-all + invest-more. /team renders referral page. Admin login → /admin sidebar has theme-toggle. /admin/products → Add product modal → hidden #product-image-upload accepts a PNG via set_input_files, returns toast 'Image uploaded' and populates image_url with /api/files/naija-invest/products/<uuid>.png.

minor.issue: Server still stores security_question_1/2 even when only one of the two is provided. Pydantic does not enforce 'all-or-none' on the 4 security fields. Low risk because /auth/reset-with-questions correctly refuses when either hash missing, but cleaner to validate at register-time.
No rate-limit (carry-over from iter_2). Acceptable for MVP.

issues: The referral code itself (large 'KGCXBIA' text) and the small 'Copy code' label appear in white/very-light tone on the light pink/coral card — extremely low contrast on mobile. The pink 'Copy invite link' CTA below is fine. Consider darkening the code text or using a contrasting indigo on the coral card.

Image preview area shows a thin empty white square when a 1x1 test PNG is uploaded — fine for production-sized photos but the preview doesn't visually indicate a successful upload at small sizes. The 'Image uploaded' toast is the only confirmation. Minor.

action_items: (Design polish) Improve contrast on /team referral-code hero card — code text barely visible on coral background.
(Optional backend hardening) Enforce all-or-none on register security_question_1/answer_1/question_2/answer_2.

(Carry-over from iter_2, not retested) Emergent badge overlapping the bottom-right of mobile bottom nav. Note: app now applies pr-28 to the bottom nav per the agent context — overlap should be mitigated.
critical_code_review_comments: routes_user.py register stores hashed answers via bcrypt (hash_password) using strip().lower() → reset path uses same normalisation, so case-insensitive comparison works correctly. Good.
routes_user.py reset-with-questions returns generic 400 'One or more answers are incorrect' — does not reveal which one. Good for privacy.

routes_admin.py /admin/upload-image validates content_type set, but does NOT sniff actual bytes (magic-number check). A bad client could send an HTML payload with content-type 'image/png'. Low risk because the file is served back as image/png and not parsed, but worth noting.
storage.py: 403 retry path resets the cached storage key and retries once — good defensive design.
server.py /api/files/{path:path} unconditionally returns 404 on any get_object exception. This swallows real storage outages as 404s; logging would help observability.
models.py RegisterRequest does not validate security_question_1/2 length or that both Qs differ — frontend enforces it but backend does not (defence in depth).
